ModGoldMimic.name: Coffer Mimic
ModGoldMimic.attack: Bite with the lid to steal gold
ModGoldMimic.special: Play Dead: lie shut as a chest for a moment
passive: Shut, you take little harm but lose gold
Bite hard the moment the hero comes close

vault.name: Coffer Mimic
vault.text: A gilded chest on claw legs that bites the hero and pockets his gold

ModGoldWarden.name: Vault Warden
ModGoldWarden.attack: Swing the great key round and down
ModGoldWarden.special: Shackle: throw the key on its chain to chain him
passive: Chained: stray too far and he is hauled back
Strongbox: hits from in front deal less

vault.name: Vault Warden
vault.text: A strongbox that learned to walk, swinging the key to itself

ModGoldRegent.name: Gilt Regent
ModGoldRegent.attack: Fire an emerald bolt from your scepter
ModGoldRegent.special: Decree: a wax seal falls on the hero
passive: Taxed, his hits feed you health
Royal Distance: a ripple pushes a close hero away

vault.name: Gilt Regent
vault.text: The crowned thing from inside the chest. It taxes every hit the hero lands

ModGoldWyrm.name: Hoard Wyrm
ModGoldWyrm.special: Molten Breath: globs that leave burning gold pools
passive: Gilding: any hit coats the hero in gold
Maul a gilded hero to shatter the gold for more

vault.name: Hoard Wyrm
vault.text: A dragon grown fat on its own hoard. Its breath pays in molten gold

ModGoldVault.name: Vault Colossus
ModGoldVault.attack: Slam both ingot fists; a quake ring knocks back
ModGoldVault.special: Payout: a gold ring, stronger for every bar banked
passive: Bank: part of each hero hit goes in, up to a cap
Each full bar also flings an ingot at the hero

vault.name: Vault Colossus
vault.text: A walking bank vault. Every blow it takes is a deposit

ModGoldSovereign.name: Gilded Sovereign
ModGoldSovereign.special: Kneel: a crown ring closes, then slams and dazes
passive: Crown Jewels orbit you and soften hits
A broken jewel flies back at him, then regrows

vault.name: Gilded Sovereign
vault.text: Crowned at last in sapphire and gold. The hero is expected to kneel

ModGoldTreasurer.name: Grand Treasurer
ModGoldTreasurer.attack: Throw three gold quills that leave slowing blots
ModGoldTreasurer.special: Audit: a ledger page falls on the hero
passive: In Debt: soon he pays a share of the harm he took
Balanced Books: no single hit can take much from you

vault.name: Grand Treasurer
vault.text: It keeps the hoard's books in gold ink, and puts the hero in debt
